block.description:
`foxfunx` is a function-only provider.

`foxfunx` includes below functions:
- `direxists` given a path, return boolean depending on directory existence. Fails for files.
- `dirempty` given a path, return boolean depending on directory content. Fails for files.
- `filecontains` given a path, return boolean depending on whether the file content matches the search string.
- `tocidr` given subnet and netmask, return subnet and netmask in the cidr format. Fails for invalid subnet or netmasks.

dirempty.description: Given a path, return boolean depending on directory content. Fails for files and non-existing directories.
dirempty.summary: `dirempty` determines whether a directory is empty.

direxists.description: Given a path, return boolean depending on directory existence. Fails for files.
direxists.summary: `direxists` determines whether a directory exists at a given path.

filecontains.description: Given a path, return boolean depending on whether the file content matches the search string.
filecontains.summary: `filecontains` determines whether search string exists in the file content.

parameters.name: search_text
parameters.description: Text to search in the file content.

variadic_parameter.name: match_case
variadic_parameter.description: Match search text case. Default to `true`. No need to pass, unless you want to set it to `false`.

tocidr.description: Given subnet and netmask, return subnet and netmask in the cidr format. Fails for invalid subnet or netmasks.
tocidr.summary: `tocidr` converts subnet and netmask to the cidr format.
